note: Evil Mode slice 8, the Gym (design Part 8a, Part 8b section KANTO, Part 29 section 12.2). Five ways to deal with a Leader: Beat, Buy, Bend, Replace, Befriend. Kanto's eight Leaders (and Janine, who inherits Fuchsia if Koga's Bend gets him his seat). Numbers are starting values, none playtested. `on: false` is the slice's undo: the Gym's a holding like any other and the panel isn't shown.

beat.needs: The Boss, in person. A Gym's never dispatched to.
beat.costs: A Gym battle at A+2, by the Gym's rule, with the Leader's gimmicks and boss gear.
beat.moves: Heat +2 (it's always the day's loudest). Dread +1. The Town's street, one colder at one in two.
beat.after: They stay. Sullen. Beating her doesn't remove her.
beat.hero: Easy: the Leader's stopped trying. The Hero learns everything the Leader knows.
beat.lose: Lose and the party's healed, the day goes on. Come back tomorrow: the Leader leads differently.

buy.needs: A Leader with a price, scouted to depth 2, and the money.
buy.costs: The price, once. There's no haggle.
buy.moves: Heat +1 if it's the day's loudest. Logged as a bribe. Each Heart: Loyalty −1.
buy.after: They stay. Ashamed, and good at hiding it. Holds while it's not found out: one in ten, each Evening.
buy.hero: Ugly. The Hero wins anyway, and learns the Gym was bought.

bend.needs: A depth-2 scout: it shows what bends them. Then the scheme, one step a day, in person.
bend.costs: The scheme's days. No odds: do them all and it's done.
bend.moves: Regard +1. The whole Roster, Loyalty +1, at the scene. The Town's street, one warmer.
bend.after: Yours, for good. Not on the Roster; on the team's side when the Hero comes.
bend.hero: The hardest in the region. They lose the first time; the district's clock isn't theirs any more. The Hero learns nothing.

replace.needs: An Officer, and a fair League challenge they win, under the Gym's rule. Grey or darker.
replace.costs: The Officer, for the region: they hold the chair and can't be sent.
replace.moves: Heat +3 (the League's told by tea-time). Regard +1 with the Saturdays kept. The Officer, Loyalty +2.
replace.after: Gone. Where depends on who they are.
replace.hero: Against the Officer. The Hero learns what the team's people are like.
replace.lose: Lost: the Officer's Loyalty +1 anyway (they were trusted to try). The way's shut for this district.

befriend.needs: Clean hands: Regard 6, a Creed they respect, and nothing on the Town's street that would turn. Grey: one road only, a Work done for them with nothing asked.
befriend.costs: A reputation. No days: it's a conversation.
befriend.moves: Regard +2. The Town's street, one warmer.
befriend.after: They stay, and look the other way. For good, unless the team breaks what earned it.
befriend.hero: Fair. The Hero learns that it's complicated.

lines.notWhatever: {They}'d not have you in the building.
lines.wouldTurn: Somebody on the Town's street would turn. {They}'ve noticed.
lines.work: One road only at Grey: a Work done for {them}, with nothing asked for it. Works come with a later build.
lines.shutLeader: "I've nothing left to lose to you."
lines.replaceRefused: Nobody on any Roster'll make the challenge.
lines.inPersonOnly: In person only: the Gym's dealt with at the In person beat.
lines.outToday: The Boss has already been out today.
lines.bendDone: The lights are off in the Gym. {name}'s sitting on the challenger's side of the floor.
lines.bought: {name} took {price}. It's logged as a bribe.
lines.beatLost: Lost to {name}. The party's healed; nothing ends. "Come back when it's yours to ask for."
lines.challengeWon: {officer} won the challenge. {name} hands over the keys.
lines.challengeLost: {officer} lost the challenge. Loyalty +1 anyway: they were trusted to try. The way's shut for this district.
lines.befriended: {name} keeps the Gym and looks the other way.
lines.foundOut: It's out: the team bought {name}. The Town's street goes one colder. Dread +1. {They}'re Shut.
lines.secondInsult: {name} heard about the Lean on the Town's street. {They}'re Shut: "I've nothing left to lose to you."
lines.firstWarning: A note from {name}: "I said a short list."
lines.heroLost: The kid lost to {name} at the Gym. They'll heal, train a day and try again.
lines.heroBadge: The kid won the Badge off {name}. {how}
lines.seat: Koga fought for the Elite Four seat himself, and got it. The Gym's Janine's.
lines.noSeat: Koga fought for the Elite Four seat himself, and didn't get it. He got the hearing.
lines.admittedFails: "You believe it. You don't do it. I can't work with the first without the second."

heroFight.beat: Easy: the Leader had stopped trying.
heroFight.buy: Ugly: the wrong sort of hard.
heroFight.bend: The hardest fight in the region.

file.beat: The Leader said: they're strong. She said it like it was the least interesting thing about them.
file.buy: It was the wrong sort of hard. They'd been paid. I don't think they liked it either.
file.replace: Spent an hour with {officer}. They were kind about it.

leader: You mended the roof. I didn't ask you to. I've been waiting to find out what it cost.
I had the constable round on Tuesday asking what I knew about you. I said: they pay on time and their lot are polite.
I'm not going to help you. I'm also not going to hinder you, and in this town that's nearly the same thing. Don't make me regret it.

profit: It cost what a roof costs. I've the receipt.
I'd rather trade in a town with a Gym than one without.
cause: Nothing. That's the point of it.
You don't have to agree with us. I'd like you to have seen us properly before you decide.
power: Somebody's in charge of every street. I'd sooner it was someone who shows up.
I'm not asking you to like it.
wonder: There's something under the hill. We'd like to look. We'd like you to know we're looking.
If it's what I think, it's yours as much as anyone's.
belonging: Half my people learned on your floor. They asked me to.
We're not going anywhere. I thought we should meet.

leaders.name: Brock
leaders.says: You're not from Pewter. You're not here to challenge either: you've not looked at the board once. There's tea in the back if you're waiting for somebody.

leaders.name: Misty
leaders.says: A river town with a cape. The Tide Doctrine's at home here.

rule.text: Water covers half the floor. Grounded Pokémon on the wet half move last. Doubles, on request.
rule.waits: The wet half of the floor isn't in the battle engine yet: it's written on the door and the fight is singles.

buy.why: She hasn't a price. Her sisters have: it's not the same thing.

bend.text: She wants it to be a Gym, not a show. The sisters' water show is in debt to a promoter, and the promoter's Rocket's.
steps: Scout the promoter's books, down by the Day Care.
Burn the debt: his ledger-house, quietly, or the ledger in the paper.
Tell the sisters, in person, that the debt's gone. They liked the show.
scene: The pool's quiet. No show tonight; there won't be one tomorrow.
"I know what you are. I know who you paid it off from."
"There's a child coming. I'll give them the best fight I've got. If they ask whose side I'm on: the town's."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit, if every Pay in the district's been fair.

replace.goes: Goes north, up the cape. Meets the Hero on Nugget Bridge and spends a day teaching them to fight on wet ground.

leaders.beaten: Fine. You're good. You're also about forty, and you came all this way to beat a Gym Leader half your age in her own pool. I hope it was everything you wanted.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Six, well trained. Write it down.
toHero.bend: I'm going to try very hard to drown you. Nothing personal. Ask me nothing about anything.
toHero.befriend: There's a team. They paid off something they didn't owe. I don't know why. Be careful, and be fair. Both.
toHero.replace: I've gone up the cape. Wet ground: lead with something that doesn't mind it.

leaders.gate: I told them I'd say one thing and go. It's this: they're not him. You've met him now. You know the difference.
leaders.walksIn: I spoke for you. To the constable, to my sisters, to a child with a Badge case. I'd like those words back, and I can't have them.

leaders.name: Lt. Surge
leaders.says: A port. The S.S. Anne's in; so's everybody's contraband.

rule.text: The bins. Two switches under two bins, next to each other; miss the second and they reset. The Boss does them too. Then singles, and his lead always outpaces.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the bins are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He was paid by a government once. He didn't like what it bought.

bend.text: The seamen's hostel on the dock shut when the fan club bought the building. Four men he served with slept there.
steps: Buy the deed off the Fan Club chairman, fairly. Listen to him about Rapidash for a whole afternoon.
Reopen the hostel: beds, a stove, a sign.
Let one of the four tell him.
scene: The dock's lights are on. Somebody's cooking in the hostel.
"I vouch for nobody. You know that."
"Kid's coming. I'll hit them with everything. Ask me about you and I've got nothing to say, loud."

leaders.respectsNote: Not Cause: "I've heard a lot of causes."

replace.goes: Goes aboard the Anne. The Hero meets him at the next port, where he's the retired Ace of that district.

leaders.beaten: Huh. Okay. You can fight. So could every guy I ever didn't like. Door's that way.

toHero.beat: They beat me fair. Don't let that fool you: fair in a ring isn't fair on a dock.
toHero.bend: Kid. I'm gonna hit you with everything. If you ask me about those people, I got nothing to say and I'll say it loud.
toHero.befriend: They keep the docks quiet. I like quiet. That's not a recommendation. That's a weather report.
toHero.replace: I'm on the Anne now. See you at the next port, kid.

leaders.gate: I've seen kids your age walk into buildings like that one angry. Walk in curious.
leaders.walksIn: I vouched. I don't vouch. Stand up when I'm talking to you.

leaders.name: Erika
leaders.says: A city: a department store, and the Game Corner under her window.

rule.text: Berries only. No bought items for either side. Status sticks: her team's built on sleep and powder.
rule.waits: The battle engine has no berries-only switch yet: the rule's on the door.

buy.why: She's a perfumer with a waiting list. You've nothing she's short of.

bend.text: The Game Corner. Children from her Saturday class go there after. She's written to the League four times.
steps: Find out whose Front the Game Corner is.
Close it: a war job, two squads, a day. Buying it and keeping it open doesn't count.
Leave the shutters down a week, and say nothing.
scene: The window over the Game Corner's dark. It smells of her perfume, not smoke.
"Somebody has shut the place under my window. I have my suspicions as to who."
"I shan't be gentle with the child. Please don't take it for dislike."

leaders.respectsNote: Never Profit: "I've met the men who say it's only business."

replace.goes: Stays in Celadon: the shop. The Gym's juniors go with her, all of them.

leaders.beaten: Oh. Well done. I'd rather hoped you wouldn't be able to. Will you take some tea, or is that not something you people do?

toHero.beat: They beat me, and then they were perfectly civil, which I found harder.
toHero.bend: I shan't be gentle. Please don't take it for dislike.
toHero.befriend: Somebody has shut the place under my window. I'm told I should mind. I find I don't.
toHero.replace: I keep a shop now. The juniors came with me. Mind your powders.

leaders.gate: In case it's the sort of room where one needs to stay awake.
leaders.walksIn: I've come without an appointment. I gather that's how it's done here.

leaders.name: Koga
leaders.says: Marsh, a Safari Zone, a warden who's lost his teeth.

rule.text: Walls nobody can see: a room before the fight, and the Boss walks it. Then poison and evasion, and a clock of fifteen turns. He wins on the clock if he's ahead.
rule.waits: Rooms and the turn clock aren't in the battle engine yet: they're on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He'd take the money and tell the League which pocket it came from. He thinks that's funny.

bend.text: He's been passed over for the Elite Four twice. Arrange the hearing: arranged, not fixed.
steps: Find the League official who lives in Fuchsia, and ask him to look at Koga properly.
Drive Koga to Indigo: two days, Wheels at the wheel.
scene: The Gym's walls are where they always are. You walk into one anyway.
"Arranged, not fixed. Good. I'd have known."
"If I get the seat, the Gym's my daughter's. You'll find you can't touch it. I thought of that. It's why I said yes."

leaders.respectsNote: Not Belonging: "A clan's a fine thing. Yours is six weeks old."

replace.goes: Vanishes. Is seen twice more in the region, behind the Hero, at a distance.

leaders.beaten: Good. Now do it when you don't know where I am.

toHero.beat: They've beaten me. A ninja's beaten often; it's how he learns where the walls are. I'll tell you where theirs are.
toHero.bend: Hardest fight I have, and nothing about anybody. You'll understand later.
toHero.befriend: There's a team in the marsh that asks before it takes. I've been waiting twenty years to see one. Watch it while it lasts.
toHero.replace: (He isn't seen. The Hero's Pokémon stop being poisoned in the grass.)

leaders.gate: (Not seen. The Hero's bag has a full antidote in it that wasn't there.)
leaders.walksIn: Your door-keeper's good. Promote her. As for the rest: I withdraw.

leaders.name: Janine
leaders.says: Koga's daughter. Sixteen. The Gym's hers now.

rule.text: Walls nobody can see, the same as her father's. She moves them.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10).

buy.why: No. She's sixteen.

bend.text: Already done: her father's seat.
steps: Already done.
scene: "Dad says hi. Dad says nothing else."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Koga, by letter, as her guardian.
leaders.beaten: Ugh! Fine. Dad's going to hear about this.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Dad says that's how you learn where the walls are.
toHero.bend: Dad says I'm to give you the hardest fight I can and say nothing about anybody. So. Hi. I'm going to be really annoying.
toHero.befriend: Dad wrote me a letter about them. He never writes letters.

leaders.name: Sabrina
leaders.says: The biggest city. Silph Co.'s tower's the neighbour's great job of the region.

rule.text: The pads: rooms joined by warp tiles, one path's right. Then singles, and she leads with whatever resists the challenger's lead.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the pads are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She already knows the figure. She's already said no. She'd like you to stop composing the offer.

bend.text: She knows what the team's for better than the Roster does. One conversation, in person, checked against the Ledger: has the team done here what its Creed says?
steps: Sit across from her and say what the team's for. She checks it against what the team's done in this district.
scene: She's already poured two cups.
"Yes. You believe it, and you do it. That's rarer than you'd think."
"The child will lose to me twice. They'll learn more from the second."

leaders.respectsNote: Whatever's true.

replace.goes: Can't be, in any test anyone's run. It's allowed. She leads with the counter to a Pokémon the Officer hasn't sent out yet.

leaders.beaten: Yes. I saw that you would. I'd hoped I was wrong about what you'd do next.

toHero.beat: They beat me. You'll beat them, on a Thursday. I'm not going to tell you which.
toHero.bend: You're going to lose to me twice. You'll learn more from the second.
toHero.befriend: You've a question about them. So have they, about you. It's the same question. I find that restful.
toHero.replace: I'm not at the Gym. I knew you'd come here first.

leaders.gate: The door on the left sticks. The person behind it's more frightened than you are. That's all I'm permitted.
leaders.walksIn: (She doesn't. Everyone who crossed a line in Saffron dreams of it the same night.)

leaders.name: Blaine
leaders.says: An island with a volcano, a lab and a burned mansion.

rule.text: The quiz. Six doors, six questions about Pokémon; a wrong answer's a junior to fight.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the quiz is on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: The mountain's going to go. The League says not in our lifetime. I've done the sums. It's for boats.
buy.other: Buy the boats yourself, and ask for nothing: a Work, about ₽9,000 and three days. It opens Befriend at Grey.

bend.text: The Mansion's diaries: he was on the project that made what's in the cave past Cerulean. Find the one with his name, hand it to him, say nothing.
steps: Dig the Mansion's archive.
Find the diary with his name in it.
Hand it to him. Say nothing.
scene: He burns it in front of the Boss.
"There's a copy in my head. That one I can't burn. Sit down."
"I'm seventy and I'm going to give the child a thrashing. It's a privilege. Theirs, I mean."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "If you're honest about it. Nobody is."

replace.goes: Stays on the island. Takes the Hero through the Mansion himself and tells them what he did.

leaders.beaten: Hah! Burned by an amateur. No, no, sit down, you've earned a riddle. What's got six legs and no future? This island.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Quiz: what do you do with someone stronger than you? You get stronger.
toHero.buy: That was a poor fight and I knew it. There are boats in the harbour that weren't there Monday. I'll let you connect the two.
toHero.bend: I'm seventy and I'm going to give you a thrashing. It's a privilege. Yours, I mean.
toHero.befriend: They bought the island boats. Thieves. I've checked the hulls for a catch. There isn't one. I'm very put out.
toHero.replace: Come through the Mansion with me. I'll tell you what I did.

leaders.gate: Quiz. What do you do with a fire you didn't start? ... No. You find out what it's burning. Go on in.
leaders.walksIn: I've seen what clever people do when nobody's told them no. I was one. I'm telling you no.

leaders.name: Giovanni
leaders.says: The neighbour's Boss, in his other chair. The Hero's eighth Badge is won off the head of Team Rocket the day before they come for the team.

toHero.beat: There's a new outfit by the coast. I meant to have them looked at. I see I've left it to a child.

leaders.name: Falkner
leaders.says: My father'd have known what you were by how you stood in the doorway. I'm still learning. Stand there a bit longer.

leaders.name: Bugsy
leaders.says: A village, a well, a charcoal kiln, a forest. Rocket's Return are in the well, cutting Slowpoke tails. He's eleven.

rule.text: The spider cars. A room. Then three each, and his Scyther's U-turn's a lesson in itself.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the spider cars are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: No. He's eleven.

bend.text: The well. Rocket's Return are down it, cutting Slowpoke tails. A Profit team that clears the well and keeps the tail trade's failed it, and the Card says so beforehand.
steps: A war job on Rocket's men in the well: one squad, a day.
Take nothing from the Slowpoke after.
scene: "I'm going to try really hard and I'm not allowed to tell you anything, sorry, that's the deal."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Kurt, who makes the Balls and has opinions: "I don't care what you call yourselves. Did you go down the well, or didn't you?"
leaders.beaten: Wow. Okay. Can I see that one again? No, the third one. How'd you get it to do that? I'm going to write this down.

toHero.beat: They beat me! It was really good. I think they're bad though? Kurt says they're bad. They were nice about my Scyther.
toHero.bend: I'm going to try really hard and I'm not allowed to tell you anything, sorry, that's the deal.
toHero.befriend: The well's clear. They did it. I asked them why and one of them said 'somebody had to' and went red.

leaders.gate: (Kurt, at the Azalea road.) I've made Balls for good trainers and bad ones. The Balls can't tell. People can. Use your eyes.
leaders.walksIn: (Kurt.) I'm seventy-three and I walked here. That should tell you how angry I am.

leaders.name: Whitney
leaders.says: A city: department store, radio tower, underground, a Game Corner the Return want back. Rackets last two days longer: there's more street to go round.

rule.text: One each, if she asks, and she does: Miltank. Otherwise three. She cries when she loses. Then she gives the Badge. Both are real.
rule.waits: One-a-side isn't in the battle engine yet: the rule's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She'd spend it by Thursday and forget what it was for. She's no use to you bought.

bend.text: Nobody takes her seriously: the Leader who cries. Get her a match on the radio against a Leader from another region who's passing through. Arranged, not fixed.
steps: Win over the radio tower's director: Persuade, or a want.
Set the match on air against a visiting Leader. She wins it or she doesn't.
scene: "I'm on the RADIO. Did you hear?"
"Anyway I'm going to flatten the kid. Rollout."

leaders.respectsNote: Belonging wholly. Profit: it's Goldenrod.

replace.goes: Goes on the radio. Has a show inside a week, and says what she thinks of the team on it, daily, to the whole region.

leaders.beaten: It's not FAIR. You're a grown-up. You've got SIX. ...Fine. Do you want the Badge? Oh. You don't. Then what did you DO that for?

toHero.beat: They beat me and didn't even want the Badge. Who does that? I'll tell you everything. Sit.
toHero.bend: I'm on the RADIO. Did you hear? Anyway I'm going to flatten you. Rollout.
toHero.befriend: They're okay. One of them carried my shopping. Don't tell Falkner I said they're okay.
toHero.replace: I've got a SHOW now. Tune in. I talk about them every day.

leaders.gate: I'm not crying. It's windy. Go and be brilliant.
leaders.walksIn: I told the WHOLE RADIO you were okay.

leaders.name: Morty
leaders.says: An old town: two towers, one burned; a dance theatre; a man in a cape who's always just leaving. The Ghosts Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The dark floor. One path's solid. Then: no switching for either side. His lead puts things to sleep and they stay there.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the dark floor and the no-switching rule are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He's waiting for a bird. You're not it.

bend.text: He's trained all his life to meet Ho-Oh and suspects he's not the one it'll come for.
steps: A Dig under the Burned Tower: three days.
Bring him what's found before anyone else sees it.
A Level, once, in person: tell him what the team wants with it.
scene: "There's a thing I'm not telling the child, and I've decided I'm at peace with that."

leaders.respectsNote: Wonder, wholly.

replace.goes: Goes to the Bell Tower's foot and waits there. The Hero finds him, and their ace gains a move.

leaders.beaten: I saw this. Not the losing: I see that often. I saw you standing there not knowing what to do with it.

toHero.beat: They won. They looked at the tower the whole time. Find out what they want with it.
toHero.bend: There's a thing I'm not telling you, and I've decided I'm at peace with that. Shall we?
toHero.befriend: They dug, and then they showed me, and then they put it back. I've no category for people like that.
toHero.replace: It won't come for me. It might for you. That's why I'm going to help.

leaders.gate: Whatever's in there, it's been looked at kindly at least once. I was there. Remember that when it's your turn to look.
leaders.walksIn: I can see how this ends for you. I'd rather hoped to stop seeing it.

leaders.name: Chuck
leaders.says: An island, a pharmacy, a waterfall, a man under it. Reach is by water. The Bruisers Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: Move the boulders; then one each, aces, no items. He's been under a waterfall since breakfast.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the boulders are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: His wife keeps the money. She'd not let him.

bend.text: The pharmacy's medicine's the only cure for miles and Rocket's Return want its supply. One job done for two Leaders.
steps: Hold the sea-lane: two water holdings, any fair way.
Carry Jasmine's medicine across when it's asked for.
scene: "You rowed it over yourselves? In that weather? HAH! Sit! Eat!"
"I'm going to hit the young'un very hard, and my wife says I'm not to gossip. HAH!"

leaders.respectsNote: Cause: "If you can say it in one breath."

replace.goes: Laughs, shakes the Officer's hand, goes back under the waterfall. Trains the Hero for a day: their weakest Pokémon gains two levels.

leaders.beaten: HAHAHA! Again! No? Then stay for lunch. You fight like you're paying off a debt. Whose?

toHero.beat: They beat me! Strong! Sad about something. I'd find out what.
toHero.bend: I'm going to hit you very hard, young'un, and my wife says I'm not to gossip. HAH!
toHero.befriend: They carried the medicine. That's all I need to know about anybody.
toHero.replace: Under the waterfall with you! A day of this and your weakest'll thank me.

leaders.gate: Chin down. Feet apart. And when they talk, LISTEN. Hardest thing in fighting.
leaders.walksIn: (He doesn't speak. He stands in the yard with his arms folded until every Grunt's come out to look. Then he shakes his head and leaves.)

leaders.name: Jasmine
leaders.says: A port, a lighthouse, a sick Ampharos at the top of it. The Gym's shut: she's upstairs at the lamp, until the medicine comes from Cianwood.

rule.text: None. Plain singles, three each. Steel doesn't need a trick.
rule.waits: Three-a-side isn't in the battle engine yet: the fight is ordinary singles.

buy.why: She'd not understand the question. She'd apologise for not understanding.

bend.text: It's the lamp. Bringing the medicine from Cianwood by a fair road is the Bend, whole: the shortest in the mode.
steps: Bring the medicine from Cianwood by a fair road: Chuck's sea-lane, or a Pay at the pharmacy and a boat.
scene: The lamp's lit.
"I'll do my best against the child. My best is quite a lot. I'm sorry in advance."

leaders.respectsNote: Anyone who brought the medicine. Otherwise Cause, Belonging.

replace.goes: Goes back up the lighthouse. Lights it for the Hero's ferry.

leaders.beaten: ...Oh. You're very good. I'm sorry, I wasn't, um. I've not slept. Would you like the Badge? You don't have to say.

toHero.beat: They beat me. I should say they're bad. They, um. They held the door for Amphy's nurse.
toHero.bend: I'll do my best against you. My best is quite a lot. I'm sorry in advance.
toHero.befriend: The lamp's lit because of them. I don't know what else they've done. I'd like not to.
toHero.replace: I'm up at the lamp. It's lit for your ferry.

leaders.gate: The light's on. If it goes badly in there, look for it. That's what it's for.
leaders.walksIn: I'm, um. I'm very disappointed. I practised saying it on the stairs.

leaders.name: Pryce
leaders.says: A lake town in the cold. A souvenir shop with a hideout under it: the Return's radio mast's driving the lake's Magikarp mad. The Tide Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: Ice floor; then hail from the first turn, and no fire item, heat pack or thawing berry sold within the district: he's had words with the shop.
rule.waits: The ice floor, the hail and the shop rule aren't in the battle engine yet: they're on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: The shop over the hideout's his sister-in-law's. They pay her rent. She's eighty-one. If they go, she's no income. He's known for a year and said nothing, and he's ashamed of both halves of that.
buy.other: Shut the hideout (a war job) and take on her rent as a Front's lease, ₽50 a day. It bends him.

bend.text: His sister-in-law's rent, and the lake. Shut the hideout and keep her income; calm the red Gyarados, not beat it.
steps: Shut the hideout under the souvenir shop: a war job.
Take on her rent as a Front's lease: ₽50 a day.
Calm the lake's red Gyarados. Don't beat it.
scene: "Winter doesn't explain itself. Neither shall I."

leaders.respectsNote: Not Power: "I was young once. I'd have liked you. I'm not, and I don't."

replace.goes: Sits by the lake. The Hero sits with him for an afternoon. No battle.

leaders.beaten: Sixty years. I've lost to better and to worse. You're in the middle. It's the middle ones I worry about.

toHero.buy: I stalled you. I was paid to. An old man can be bought with his family's rent. Remember it: it'll be true of you one day.
toHero.bend: Winter doesn't explain itself. Neither shall I.
toHero.befriend: They saw to the lake. They saw to Edith. They did not have to do the second. I've been thinking about the second.
toHero.replace: Sit. No battle. Watch the lake with me a while.

leaders.gate: Patience. They've had six weeks. You've had six weeks. Neither of you knows anything yet. Go and not know it together.
leaders.walksIn: I buried a wife and a partner and I didn't say a word at either. I've a word for you.

leaders.name: Clair
leaders.says: Dragons, a cave behind the Gym, and a Leader who won't hand over the Badge until the Hero's passed the Elder's questions. The Hero does both in a day.

toHero.beat: The Elder asked you what a Pokémon is to you. Ask them. Whatever they say, that's what they are.

leaders.name: Roxanne
leaders.says: You're taking notes. Good. I'm a teacher: I notice. I'd be interested to mark them.

leaders.name: Brawly
leaders.says: An island, a cave, a beach, a phrase everyone's saying this week. Reach is by water. The Bruisers and Tide Doctrines are at home.

rule.text: Dark. The floor lights as juniors are beaten. Then three each; he bulks up and waits.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the dark floor is on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He owns a board and a bag. He's not short of anything.

bend.text: Granite Cave's wall-paintings: Aqua and Magma both want what they show, and neither's careful.
steps: Hold the cave: wild ground, by calm or by a fair fight.
Post one person there for the district: two days.
scene: He comes by on the second day and brings them lunch.
"I'm gonna go big on the kid, and I'm not gonna say why I'm stoked."

leaders.respectsNote: Power: "Big wave, somebody's gotta ride it."

replace.goes: Surfs to the next island. Meets the Hero on a beach and teaches them to wait.

leaders.beaten: Whoa. Heavy. No, that was sick, don't look so grim about it. You always this tense? You should get in the water.

toHero.beat: They wiped me out, bro. Strong. Zero chill. Here's what they ran.
toHero.bend: I'm gonna go big on you, and I'm not gonna say why I'm stoked. Deal?
toHero.befriend: There's a crew keeping the cave clean. They're kinda criminals? The cave's clean though.
toHero.replace: Don't throw everything on turn one, bro. Wait for the set.

leaders.gate: Big set coming. Don't fight the first one. Read it.
leaders.walksIn: Not cool. That's it. That's the whole thing I came to say. Not cool.

leaders.name: Wattson
leaders.says: A crossroads city: a cycle shop, a Game Corner, and New Mauville, shut, under the sea road. Fronts and rackets both pay well. The Machines Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The switches. Barriers up and down. Then singles; paralysis on everything; he laughs throughout.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the switches are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: New Mauville. He built it. The generator's running wild down there and the city won't pay to shut it. He'd take your money, shut it, and tell you a joke. It's for the generator.
buy.other: Go down and shut it yourself: in person, or a Hands squad, two days. It opens Befriend at Grey.

bend.text: New Mauville finished: not just shut.
steps: Shut the generator under the sea road.
Fund the works: a Work, about ₽6,000 and three days (Machines halves it).
scene: He cries. He says it's the ozone.
"Wahaha! I'm going to light the sprout up like the Saturday market! Ask me no questions, I'll tell you no jokes!"

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: it's a merchant's city, and he likes a fair one.

replace.goes: Retires, loudly, to the Game Corner. Wins. Gives it to the Hero for supplies.

leaders.beaten: WAHAHAH! Shocked! Me! That's the joke, you see, because I'm... no? Tough room. Well fought. You're not laughing. Somebody ought to see to that.

toHero.buy: I wasn't at my best, sprout. There's a reason and it's under the sea road, humming. Go and look, after.
toHero.bend: Wahaha! I'm going to light you up like the Saturday market! Ask me no questions, I'll tell you no jokes!
toHero.befriend: They paid for my city. Out of their own, er, takings. I've stopped asking what from. Wahah. Hah.
toHero.replace: Wahaha! Won big at the Corner, sprout. Spend it on supplies!

leaders.gate: Here's one. Why did the trainer cross the road? ... To find out what the other side wanted. It's not funny. It's just true. Off you go.
leaders.walksIn: (Wattson came. He wasn't laughing.)

leaders.name: Flannery
leaders.says: A hot-spring town under Mt. Chimney. Magma's on the mountain with a machine. An old folks' bath; a herb shop. The Ember Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: Steam vents; then sun from the first turn. She over-reaches: her lead uses its strongest move and is weaker after.
rule.waits: The steam vents and the sun aren't in the battle engine yet: they're on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She's been Leader four months. She'd report you to her grandfather, who was Elite Four, and then ask him if that was the right thing to do.

bend.text: She's trying to be the Leader she thinks a Leader is. The mountain: a war job on Magma's machine, and she comes.
steps: A war job on Magma's machine on Mt. Chimney, with her along.
The Boss, in person, fights beside her against a Magma Admin.
After, she asks: "Was that all right? Was I all right?" The Boss's answer's the Bend.
scene: "Was that all right? Was I all right?"
"I'm going to be really, properly good this time. Watch."

leaders.respectsNote: Anyone who's straight with her. She wants to think well of people.

replace.goes: Goes to her grandfather's. Comes back in the Reckoning, on the Hero's road, twice as good.

leaders.beaten: I... no. Right. A Leader says: well fought. Well fought. ... Was I terrible? You can say. I'd rather know.

toHero.beat: They beat me and I asked them how I did. I ASKED them. Don't tell anyone.
toHero.bend: I'm going to be really, properly good this time. Watch.
toHero.befriend: They went up the mountain with me. One of them said I'd done well and I think they meant it. Is that allowed?
toHero.replace: I've been at Grandad's. I'm better now. Twice as. Let's go.

leaders.gate: I came to say something wise. I've forgotten it. Just: don't pretend to be anybody. It doesn't work. I checked.
leaders.walksIn: I told Grandad you were all right. I have to go and tell him I was wrong. Do you know what that's LIKE?

leaders.name: Norman
leaders.says: A quiet town between woods and sea. A boy called Wally who's ill and wants one Pokémon. If Hoenn's the first region, this is the Hero's father's town.

rule.text: Choose your doors: speed, accuracy, defence; each room's juniors use that. Then singles, five each. He's the strongest of the six.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the doors are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He moved his family across the sea for this job. Think.

bend.text: Nothing, if he's the Hero's father: "Not him." Otherwise: Wally. The boy needs someone to walk him to the long grass and Norman's not had the afternoon.
steps: A Grunt with Heart, a day: walk Wally to the long grass. The Ralts is his for good.
scene: Wally's got a Ralts. Norman's at the window.
"I'll not go easy on the child. I never have."

leaders.respectsNote: A parent's list.

replace.goes: Goes home. He's got one. Can't be, if he's the Hero's father: no Officer'll make the challenge. "That's the kid's dad, Boss."

leaders.beaten: You're strong. I've spent my life getting strong so I'd be worth something to my family when I got home. What's yours for?

toHero.beat: They beat me. I'm fine. Listen: they're good, and they're in a hurry, and people in a hurry leave doors open. Look for the doors.
toHero.befriend: I've met the one in charge. I'm not going to tell you what I thought. You're old enough to think it yourself. Ring your mother.

leaders.gate: (A letter, read on the Hero's walk in.) I'm not there because you don't need me there. That's the best thing I've ever been able to say to anyone.
leaders.walksIn: I let my child walk toward you with an open mind. I want you to understand exactly what you've done with that.

leaders.name: Winona
leaders.says: A town in the trees, rope bridges, long grass, rain. The Weather Institute's upriver: Aqua's got it. Vans can't cross the bridges.

rule.text: The turning gates. Then singles under whatever weather's outside: the roof's open.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the turning gates are on the door, and outside weather isn't in the battle engine yet: the fight is singles.

buy.why: She's above it. Literally. She lives in a tree.

bend.text: The Weather Institute. A Profit team that keeps the Institute's forecasts for its own boats has failed it.
steps: A war job on Aqua at the Weather Institute: two squads. The staff are locals and want it back.
Publish the forecast after. Don't sell it.
scene: The forecast's pinned up on the quay.
"I shall be very high and very fast. I shan't be answering questions from that altitude."

leaders.respectsNote: Belonging: "If it lets people leave."

replace.goes: Flies. The Hero's next district has clear weather throughout and nobody says why.

leaders.beaten: Gracefully done. I mean that as a description. I don't yet mean it as a compliment.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Elegantly. Elegance isn't goodness. I've confused the two before.
toHero.bend: I shall be very high and very fast. Do try to keep up. I shan't be answering questions from that altitude.
toHero.befriend: They gave the forecast back to the fishermen. A small thing. I judge people by small things.
toHero.replace: (Not seen. The sky's clear all the way to the next town.)

leaders.gate: From up there you can see the whole of it: their base, your road, the town between. It's all one landscape. Mind you fight like it.
leaders.walksIn: I came by the window. I'll leave by the door, so that everyone in your corridor sees which way I'm facing.

leaders.name: Tate and Liza
leaders.says: An island with a Space Center. Magma wants the fuel. Steven's house, empty. Reach by water. They're twelve.

rule.text: Doubles. Always. The two of them, one mind. A squad or a Boss without two Pokémon that work together loses here whatever the levels.
rule.waits: Double battles aren't in the battle engine yet: the rule's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: No. They're twelve.

bend.text: The Space Center. Hold its two approaches through the day Magma comes, with the Boss there in person.
steps: Hold the Space Center's two approaches: holdings, any fair way.
Hold them through day 4, when Magma comes.
The Boss, in person, fights beside the twins against two Admins.
scene: They finish each other's sentences throughout. So, by the end, does one of the Grunts.
"We're not telling—" "—anything—" "—and we're going to win." "Probably."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of their father, at the Space Center: "Do you want the rocket to go up, or do you want to own it? It's a real question. I get asked to choose daily."
leaders.beaten: Tate: "We lost." Liza: "We did." Tate: "They weren't in step though." Liza: "No. They won anyway." Both: "That's worse."

toHero.beat: "They beat us—" "—and they weren't even friends with their own Pokémon—" "—well, two were." "Two were."
toHero.bend: "We're not telling—" "—anything—" "—and we're going to win." "Probably."
toHero.befriend: "They stood with us at the Center." "They did." "We don't know what they are." "We know what they did."

leaders.gate: (Their father, on the Mossdeep quay.) I spend my life pointing things at the sky and hoping. You're a better bet than most of them. Go on.
leaders.walksIn: (Their father.) I've taken an afternoon off. I've not done that in nine years. Don't waste it by explaining.

leaders.name: Juan
leaders.says: A crater city reached under water, an ice floor, and a Leader who taught the Champion. The Hero's had to learn to dive to get here.

toHero.beat: I have taught elegance for forty years. There's a kind that's only manners, and a kind that goes all the way down. Yours is to find out which they have.

leaders.name: Roark
leaders.says: Sorry: hard hat. Rules. You're not miners. You've got clean boots and you keep looking at who's looking at you. Mind the cart.

leaders.name: Gardenia
leaders.says: An old town by a forest. A statue nobody can read; a cycle shop whose owner's missing; an empty chateau in the woods; and the Galactic Eterna Building, which is theirs from day one.

rule.text: The flower clock. Juniors hide in it; the floor turns as they're found. Then three each, and her last one hits far harder than its size.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the flower clock's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She'd be embarrassed for you.

bend.text: The cycle shop's owner's being held in the Galactic building; so's a Clefairy that isn't theirs.
steps: A war job on the Galactic Eterna Building: two squads, or the Boss in person.
Let both out, with nothing asked: two days.
scene: Rad's back in his shop by evening. She doesn't come by. She sends a pot plant.
"I'm going to go all out and I'm not going to gossip, and both of those are really hard for me."

leaders.respectsNote: Spite: "…Against them in the building? Then I didn't hear you say it."

replace.goes: Goes into the forest. Shows the Hero the moss rock; the Hero's team gains an evolution it wouldn't have had.

leaders.beaten: Oof. You're way stronger than you look, and you look like trouble. Okay. So what happens now? Because I'm not giving you the keys.

toHero.beat: They beat me. They were polite about it, which honestly made it creepier.
toHero.bend: I'm going to go all out and I'm not going to gossip, and both of those are really hard for me.
toHero.befriend: They got Rad out of that building. The spacemen had him a WEEK and the police did nothing. I know what they are. I also know who came.
toHero.replace: There's a rock in the forest with moss on it. Stand next to it. Trust me.

leaders.gate: It's not haunted. I checked. Well, I asked someone who checked. Go on. You're braver than me.
leaders.walksIn: I walked through the whole forest to get here, in the dark, and I hate the dark. So you know I mean it.

leaders.name: Maylene
leaders.says: A stone city on a hill: a department store, a Game Corner, warehouses, and Galactic's headquarters, with a satellite dish, in plain view. Four holdings are theirs. The Bruisers Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The punching bags: slide them to clear a path. Then three each, no items for either side: "It's cheating if it's in a bottle."
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the punching bags are on the door, the fight is singles, and no-items waits on the battle engine.

buy.why: Her father's at the Game Corner every day the Gym pays her. She's skipped meals to train. The price is his debt, to the last coin; she's worked it out on the back of a challenger form.
buy.other: Pay the Game Corner directly and tell her nothing (she finds out a day on), or win the Corner's deed and bar him. Either opens Befriend at Grey.

bend.text: The debt, cleared the honest way, and a meal.
steps: Clear her father's Game Corner debt, the honest way.
Send food from the Mess to the Gym: a Night action, no Card. It needs a kitchen.
scene: "They sent soup. Who sends soup?"
"I'm going to hit as hard as I can! I had breakfast!"

leaders.respectsNote: Belonging, wholly.

replace.goes: Walks barefoot to the next town. Spars with the Hero for a day; the Hero's lead gains a fighting move.

leaders.beaten: Thank you for the match! … Sorry. I always say that. I mean it though. You're really strong. Are you all right? You look like you've not eaten either.

toHero.buy: I didn't fight you properly. I'm sorry. It's my dad. That's not an excuse. Come back and I'll do it right.
toHero.bend: I'm going to hit as hard as I can! I had breakfast!
toHero.befriend: They sent soup. Who sends soup? I don't know what to think about them. It was good soup.
toHero.replace: I walked here barefoot. We're sparring. All day. You'll thank me.

leaders.gate: Bend your knees. Breathe out when you get hit. And eat something first. I mean it.
leaders.walksIn: I trusted you. I don't trust people! I trusted you!

leaders.name: Crasher Wake
leaders.says: Marsh town by the sea. The Great Marsh, a Croagunk on every sign, and a Galactic Grunt with a bomb who's running in circles. The Tide Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The water level: three buttons raise and lower it. Then singles; he sings.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the water level's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He's a masked wrestler who gives his purses to the Marsh fund. Next.

bend.text: The Marsh, and beyond it Lake Valor, where Galactic'll set the bomb off on day 5.
steps: Catch the Grunt with the bomb: a chase over three holdings, each a short battle, in person or by a Wheels squad.
Disarm it: Hands.
Do it by day 4, and the lake's not drained.
scene: The Magikarp aren't on the mud. Wake knows who did it.
"THE CRASHER WILL BREAK YOU, CHILD! And then buy you chips. No questions."

leaders.respectsNote: Power: "A good heel knows he's a heel!"

replace.goes: Goes on tour. The Hero sees his poster in every later town, and in the last one, him. He carries the Hero's bag up a hill.

leaders.beaten: GWAHAHA! PINNED! One, two, three! No, don't help me up, it's part of the show. … It's not a show to you, is it. Pity.

toHero.beat: They beat the Crasher! Clean fall! Now listen up, here's their whole card, top to bottom.
toHero.bend: THE CRASHER WILL BREAK YOU, CHILD! And then buy you chips. No questions.
toHero.befriend: They saved the lake! Villains! In my marsh! Being DECENT! Thirty years in this business and I can't tell who's the face any more.
toHero.replace: Give us the bag, kid. It's a big hill. The Crasher carries.

leaders.gate: Every match has a story, kid. Make sure you know which one you're in before the bell.
leaders.walksIn: (He takes the mask off. That's the scene.)

leaders.name: Fantina
leaders.says: A warm city: a contest hall, a church with no doctrine, a park for walking Pokémon, a fan club. People here like to be talked to.

rule.text: Sums on the doors; then singles in the dark, and style: a challenger who wins without ever using a non-damaging move's told it didn't count.
rule.waits: The sums are on the door and the fight is singles; the style rule waits on the battle engine.

buy.why: She came across the sea with nothing and built that. She'd laugh, in two languages.

bend.text: A fair chance for the district's young: the Contest Hall's entry fee's gone up and the children can't pay it.
steps: Take the Hall's manager: a fair Pay, or a Persuade (he wants a full house).
Waive the fee: the holding pays ₽0, for good.
Then enter: a Grunt, in a contest, in person. It needn't be won. It needs doing without irony.
scene: A Grunt dances in the Hall, very badly, with a Zubat. She's in the front row.
"I will be dazzling. You will be dazzled. We will not discuss my friends."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "if it has taste."

replace.goes: Returns to the Hall. Coaches the Hero's weakest Pokémon through one contest; its Bond's doubled for the region.

leaders.beaten: Ohohoho! Magnifique. No: I do not mean it. You won like a clerk filing a paper. Where is your joy? Come back when you have found some.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Très efficient. Très sad. You, at least, you fight as if it matters.
toHero.bend: I will be dazzling. You will be dazzled. We will not discuss my friends.
toHero.befriend: Their little one danced in my Hall, very badly, with a Zubat. I have not been so moved in years.
toHero.replace: Your smallest one, mon petit. Give it to me for one contest. It will come back taller.

leaders.gate: Whatever you do in there, mon petit: do it beautifully. It is the only thing that lasts.
leaders.walksIn: I do not make scenes. I am about to make one. Sit where the light is bad for you.

leaders.name: Byron
leaders.says: A harbour town split by a canal: a library of old stories, a boat to Iron Island, a sailor's son who can't wake up. Digs pay double. The Machines Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: Lifts, up and down between platforms. Then four each; his team doesn't go down to anything that isn't the right type, and he says so.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the lifts are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He'd bury the money and dig it up in ten years to see if it'd improved.

bend.text: Not for him: the sailor's boy, in the house by the dock, in a nightmare that won't lift. The cure's on Fullmoon Island.
steps: A boat: a night boat favour, or a held ferry.
An Escort to Fullmoon Island: two days, Wheels.
Bring back the feather. Nothing else is taken from the island.
scene: He comes down to the dock when the boat's back, says nothing at all, and helps tie up.
"I'm a wall. You're going to run at me for an hour. It'll do you good."

leaders.respectsNote: Wonder: he digs. A team that was fair to Oreburgh starts a step up: "My lad says you were all right. He's soft. So was his mother. She was usually right."

replace.goes: Goes to Iron Island. The Hero finds him there with a man in a blue hat; the Hero's team gains an egg.

leaders.beaten: Hrm! Sturdy. I thought my defence'd hold. It didn't. That's information. I like information. I don't like you yet.

toHero.beat: They got through my steel. Not many do. Here's how; I've drawn it.
toHero.bend: I'm a wall. You're going to run at me for an hour. It'll do you good.
toHero.befriend: They fetched the feather for the Eldritch boy. Didn't sell it, didn't keep it. I've buried better men who'd have kept it.
toHero.replace: Found an egg down here. Take it. Don't drop it. Dig in.

leaders.gate: Dig in. Not your heels: your self. Know what you're stood on before you swing.
leaders.walksIn: I told my son you were all right. Now I've to tell him his father was a fool. I've not had to do that before.

leaders.name: Candice
leaders.says: The far north: snow, a temple, a lake, a port. Squads sent far need a safehouse halfway. Galactic's at Lake Acuity from day 3. The Ghosts and Tide Doctrines manage; Ember's Grunts complain.

rule.text: Ice floor, snowballs: slide to break them. Then hail from the first turn, and her team's moves don't miss in it.
rule.waits: Hail isn't in the battle engine yet: the ice floor's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She'd tell the whole class. She tells the whole class everything.

bend.text: The temple she keeps and isn't supposed to let anyone into; and Lake Acuity.
steps: Hold the lake's two shores through day 3, any fair way.
When Jupiter comes for the lake: the Boss, in person.
scene: She lets the Boss into the temple. Under Wonder the Card says "clean" before the stamp's dry.
"It's ON. I can't tell you stuff, but I can tell you it's ON."

leaders.respectsNote: She can be Befriended at Regard 5.

replace.goes: Stays, and teaches at the Trainers' School; the school's the Gym now, whatever the sign says. Every child in town tells the Hero to go and see Miss Candice.

leaders.beaten: Whoa! Okay! You've totally got focus. Like, scary focus. What's it all aimed at? No, really, I'm asking, I've got till the bell.

toHero.beat: They beat me! Super focused. I don't think they're happy though? You can be both, you know. I'm both.
toHero.bend: It's ON. I can't tell you stuff, but I can tell you it's ON.
toHero.befriend: They stood on the lake in a blizzard for two days so the space people couldn't have it. Then one of them asked if I had a spare scarf. I knitted her one.
toHero.replace: Class is in! Sit down, you're late. Focus is knowing what you love. Write that down.

leaders.gate: Focus isn't staring really hard. It's knowing what you love. Okay, go, you'll freeze standing there.
leaders.walksIn: I knitted one of you a SCARF.

leaders.name: Volkner
leaders.says: A city on solar walkways, a lighthouse, and a Leader so bored he's rebuilt the Gym three times and blacked out the town doing it. The Hero's the first challenger in a year to wake him up.

toHero.beat: That's the first time I've felt anything in this room for a year. If the one in that base can make you fight like that again, I almost envy them.

leaders.name: Cilan, Chili and Cress
leaders.says: Cress: "A table for...? Ah. Not dining." Chili: "They're casing the place!" Cilan: "Chili. They're customers until they aren't. Tea?"

leaders.name: Lenora
leaders.says: Warehouses turned to studios, a museum with a library at the back and a dragon's skeleton at the front. Plasma wants the skull. Digs and Archives pay double.

rule.text: The books. A question's answer's in the next book. Then three each; her lead hits first, retreats, and comes back fresh.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the books are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She's a museum director. She's refused better bribes from better-dressed people for worse reasons.

bend.text: The skull. On day 3 Plasma takes it, and it goes back to the plinth, not the Wall.
steps: Stop it: hold the museum's door, in person, on day 3.
Or fetch it back from Pinwheel Forest: a chase, day 4.
Return it to the plinth. A Wonder team that keeps it has its Key, not clean, and Lenora in the base by Night.
scene: Hawes checks it for substitution. Twice. It's the original.
"I'm going to be very difficult, dear. It's for your own good."

leaders.respectsNote: Wonder: if it puts things back.

replace.goes: Stays: she's still the director. The Gym's through the back of her museum and the Officer walks past her desk every morning.

leaders.beaten: Mm. Well, you've done your reading. I'll say that. Now tell me what you're going to do with what you've learned, because that's the part I mark.

toHero.beat: They beat me, and thoroughly. I've catalogued their team. Here.
toHero.bend: I'm going to be very difficult, dear. It's for your own good.
toHero.befriend: They brought the skull back. I checked it for substitution. Twice. It's the original. I don't quite know what to do with that.

leaders.gate: Everything in a museum was somebody's, once. Remember that about everything in there. And everyone.
leaders.walksIn: I'm going to say this once, slowly, as I would to a donor.

leaders.name: Burgh
leaders.says: The biggest city in the mode: five piers, a plaza, an ice-cream queue, a street of offices. Rackets last longer and Fronts pay more, but there's a police box on every corner.

rule.text: Honey walls. Push through. Then three each; his art's in the switching.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the honey walls are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He's an artist with a patron. You'd be the second patron. He's told the first one no for years.

bend.text: He's stuck: he hasn't finished a canvas in a year. Asked what he wanted, he said: "To be surprised."
steps: Nothing the team can plan. Do three things he can see from his studio window that he didn't expect.
A waived fee; a Give It Back; a Grunt carrying somebody's shopping. The rail counts: "Surprised: 2 of 3."
scene: The studio light's on past midnight.
"I'm painting again! So I shall be merciless. It's how I show joy."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "It's so boring, though. Isn't it?"

replace.goes: Goes to Pinwheel Forest to paint. Paints the Hero. The Hero's mother gets the picture; it's in the epilogue, on a wall.

leaders.beaten: Oh! Oh, that was— no. Technically lovely. Emotionally a spreadsheet. Who hurt you? I'm serious. I'd like to paint it.

toHero.beat: They beat me. There was no inspiration in it. You've got some. Guard it.
toHero.bend: I'm painting again! So I shall be merciless. It's how I show joy.
toHero.befriend: I've been watching them from my window. They're a muddle. I adore a muddle.
toHero.replace: (A parcel, brown paper. It's a painting of you. It's rather good.)

leaders.gate: Look at it properly before you fight it. Nobody ever looks at anything properly. That's my whole career.
leaders.walksIn: (He's brought the canvas. He turns it to the wall.) I'd started one of you.

leaders.name: Elesa
leaders.says: A city of entertainments: a musical theatre, two stadiums, a big wheel, a subway. Plasma's king rides the wheel and talks to anyone who gets in the car.

rule.text: The coaster. Switch the track. Then three each, at speed: hers switch on every hit.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the coaster's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She's a model. Her day rate's more than your Garage.

bend.text: A girl in town's stopped leaving the house because her father thinks the routes are too dangerous. He's right. It's partly the team.
steps: Make the two routes out of Nimbasa safe for the district: no rackets, no Leans, no war jobs on them.
One Escort, in person, to the gate.
scene: Elesa's watching from the runway.
"I'm going to stun you, in every sense. No interviews after."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: she's a professional. Befriended at Regard 5 if nobody's been Leaned on in Nimbasa at all.

replace.goes: Goes back to modelling full-time. The Hero's on a poster with her within the week, and everyone's seen it.

leaders.beaten: ...Dazzling. No, I mean it. I'm just not sure you enjoyed it. I find that's the tell.

toHero.beat: They outshone me. It happens. They didn't smile once. Here's their order.
toHero.bend: I'm going to stun you, in every sense. No interviews after.
toHero.befriend: The road's safe. Bianca's dad let her go. I asked who to thank and was given a name I'm not supposed to say.
toHero.replace: (A poster, on every hoarding in Nimbasa: Elesa, and you.)

leaders.gate: Shoulders back. Walk in like it's yours. Then be kind. That's the whole trick, in any room.
leaders.walksIn: I had a shoot. I cancelled it. That's never happened. Think about how angry I'd have to be.

leaders.name: Clay
leaders.says: A cold harbour with a drawbridge he controls, a market, a mine and a cold store. He owns half of it. The bridge is down, or not, as he pleases. The Machines and Bruisers Doctrines are at home.

rule.text: The lifts, down. The Gym's a mine. Then three each; his are slow and it doesn't matter.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the lifts are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He'd buy you. He's asked what you'd cost.
buy.other: He's the one Leader who makes the team an offer: day 2, at the base. Plasma out of his cold store and the bridge stays down. A contract, not a favour.

bend.text: The cold store: Plasma Grunts in the freezer, with one of the Seven Sages. And a deal kept.
steps: A war job on the cold store, in person.
Hand the Sage to Clay. Not kept: a team that keeps him has leverage on Plasma and no bridge.
scene: "Y'all're a business. Ah know a business. That's a contract, not a favour."
"Ah'm in business with some folk. Ain't yer concern. Mah Excadrill's yer concern."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit, wholly: "At least y'all're honest about it." Cause: "Ah've heard the speech. Plasma gives it better."

replace.goes: Can't be: he owns the building. An Officer who beats him's told: "Fair enough. Rent's ₽2,000 a day."

leaders.beaten: Hrmph. Ye've got grit. Ah'll not say more'n that, 'cause ah don't hand out more'n ah owe.

toHero.beat: They whupped me. Fair. Ah don't hold it against 'em and ah don't hold it for 'em.
toHero.bend: Ah'm in business with some folk. Ain't yer concern. Mah Excadrill's yer concern.
toHero.befriend: They do what they say. In mah experience that's rarer'n gold and worth about the same.

leaders.gate: Don't go in there to win an argument, young'un. Go in to make a deal ye can both live with. Them's different jobs.
leaders.walksIn: We had a contract. (The bridge is up for the rest of the region.)

leaders.name: Skyla
leaders.says: An airstrip, greenhouses, and a tower on a hill where a bell's rung for Pokémon that've died. One squad a day can be flown anywhere the team holds.

rule.text: Cannons. She fires challengers across the room, the Boss too. Then three each; hers outspeed.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the cannons are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She'd think it was a tip for the flight.

bend.text: She once flew past an injured Pokémon on the tower's roof and told herself it was too far to be sure. A sick one's at the top again this week.
steps: Climb Celestial Tower, in person: up through the graves, no battles unless the Boss disturbs anything.
Ring the bell after.
scene: She hears it from the airstrip. The Card's "Gives": "A bell, rung."
"Chocks away! No chit-chat on this flight!"

replace.goes: Flies cargo. Flies the Hero, once, over the whole region: every held holding, as a colour. The File gains a map.

leaders.beaten: Wow! You flew right past me! That was great! ...You're not going to tell me that was fun, are you? Oh. You're one of those.

toHero.beat: They beat me! Great pilots. Bit grim. Here's what I saw from above.
toHero.bend: Chocks away! No chit-chat on this flight!
toHero.befriend: Somebody climbed the tower and rang the bell for a stranger's Pokémon. Grandpa says you can tell everything about a person by whether they'd climb the stairs.
toHero.replace: Hop in. I'll show you the whole of it from up top. You'll want a map after.

leaders.gate: From high enough up, it all looks small. You, them, the whole fight. I find that helps. Go get 'em.
leaders.walksIn: I landed on your roof. Sorry about the tiles. Not sorry about what I'm going to say.

leaders.name: Brycen
leaders.says: A marsh town that freezes: a tower with a dragon's legend in it, a moor, a house with a fan club. Plasma's Shadow Triad are seen here. The Ghosts Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: Ice floor, long slides. Then three each. He was an actor, and fights like a man who's learned a part completely.
rule.waits: The ice floor isn't in the battle engine yet: it's on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He left the pictures at the top of his fame, for a mountain. Money's the thing he walked away from.

bend.text: He stopped acting after an injury and has told nobody he misses it.
steps: Nothing on the rail. A Night knock, only in Icirrus at Regard 4 or more: a man in a mask asks, formally, to perform for the Roster.
Grant it. Loyalty +1, everyone. He offers nothing after.
scene: The rail, next morning, reads: "Bent."
"I shall be at my sharpest. Think of it as a first night."

leaders.respectsNote: Power: "I've played tyrants. They're easy. That's what's wrong with them."

replace.goes: Returns to the pictures. His new one's about a child and a crime lord. The Hero's sure who the child is, and less sure about the crime lord.

leaders.beaten: A fine performance. I mean yours. I recognise one. I'd be curious to see you without it.

toHero.beat: They defeated me. With discipline. Discipline in service of what, I could not tell.
toHero.bend: I shall be at my sharpest. Think of it as a first night.
toHero.befriend: I've met their company. Amateurs. Devoted ones. I was oddly touched.
toHero.replace: (A poster in Opelucid: Brycen, back on the screen. The villain's coat looks familiar.)

leaders.gate: The mask is so you can say the true thing. Take yours off inside. Insist they do the same.
leaders.walksIn: (In the mask. He takes it off to speak. Anyone on the Roster who saw the performance: Loyalty −2.)

leaders.name: Drayden
leaders.says: An old city, or a new one; a mayor who's also the Leader, and a girl he's raising who'll be Champion. Dragons, on a floor shaped like two more.

toHero.beat: Two teams in my region both say they're doing good. One's lying outright. The other may not know whether it is. That's the one you're walking to.

leaders.name: Viola
leaders.says: Hold it— click. Sorry. Habit. You've an interesting face. It's doing two things at once. I'll send you a print, if you leave an address. No? Thought not.

leaders.name: Grant
leaders.says: A seaside town under cliffs: a cycle race, a climbing wall, a cave with fossils and Flare Grunts in it. Reach +1 for a squad led by anyone who'll climb.

rule.text: The wall. The Gym's a climb and the juniors are on ledges. Then three each: he likes anyone who doesn't look down.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the wall is on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: He climbs things because they're there. He'd climb past the money.

bend.text: The fossil cave. Flare's turned a scientist's assistant out of it, and the fossil's to stay with the lab.
steps: A war job on the cave, or an Outplay against the Flare Admin in person: two days.
The fossil stays with the lab.
scene: He races the Boss up the wall after. Losing's fine. Refusing isn't: "Go on. Nobody's watching."
"I'm setting you the hardest line on the wall. I shan't be offering beta."

leaders.respectsNote: Power: "The wall doesn't care who's in charge either."

replace.goes: Cycles the coast. Lends the Hero a bike, and they reach the next district a day early.

leaders.beaten: Well climbed. I say that to anyone who gets to the top. What I'd like to know's what you thought the view'd be.

toHero.beat: They topped out before me. Efficient route. No joy in the ascent. Here's their holds.
toHero.bend: I'm setting you the hardest line on the wall. I shan't be offering beta.
toHero.befriend: They turned Flare out of the cave and left the fossil where it lay. I've climbed with worse people.

leaders.gate: Three points of contact. Don't look down. And when you reach the top, look properly: the view's the reason.
leaders.walksIn: (He's come up the outside of the building.) I wanted to see if your walls were as bad as your judgement.

leaders.name: Korrina
leaders.says: A coastal town with a tower in the sea that the tide cuts off. Reach to the tower only at low tide: two days in three. She's young; her grandfather's the one a Boss talks to.

rule.text: Skates: rails and ramps. Then three each, and from Region 2 hers Mega Evolves whether or not the gimmick count says so. It's what the tower's for.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the rails are on the door, the fight is singles, and her Mega Evolution isn't forced yet.

buy.why: She'd roller-skate round you while refusing.

bend.text: Her grandfather doesn't think she's ready for the tower. He's set her a test and she's failed it twice. It's hers to pass; the team can be the opponents she needs.
steps: Three Outplays, in person, over three days, each harder, each fought to win.
She loses the first two. The third's the Bend, whoever wins it.
scene: Gurkinn's watching from the gallery. "Hm," he says. It's high praise.
"Lucario and I've been training against the best lately! Not saying who!"

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Gurkinn, at the tower: she's young, and he's the one a Boss talks to.

replace.goes: Goes to the tower and trains. Comes down for the Reckoning and fights the Hero on the road. They lose. She tells them why. They win the next six in a row.

leaders.beaten: Whoa! Time out! That was AWESOME. You've got a real bond with— huh. With two of them. What's up with the other four?

toHero.beat: They beat me, and two of their six really love them. The other four are just… working. I thought that was interesting.
toHero.bend: Lucario and I've been training against the best lately! Not saying who!
toHero.befriend: Grandpa says you can read a trainer's heart in a battle. I read theirs. It was messier than I expected. Kinda sweet in places.

leaders.gate: Your Pokémon know what you're feeling before you do. So figure it out before you go in, yeah? For their sake.
leaders.walksIn: (She skates in. She doesn't do a trick. The Roster notices that she doesn't.)

leaders.name: Ramos
leaders.says: A town in two halves, hill and harbour, joined by a monorail. A great tree, a hotel, and past the hills the power plant, which Flare's drawing off. Wild ground's five.

rule.text: The ropes: climb and swing. Then three each, slow: he plants something on turn one that pays out on turn five.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the ropes are on the door, and the slow planting isn't in the battle engine yet: the fight is singles.

buy.why: He's eighty and he gardens. What'd he spend it on? Compost. He makes his own.

bend.text: The power plant. The city down the line's going dark, and the old folk on the hill side can't use the monorail.
steps: A war job on the plant, in person: a reverse dungeon of four rooms.
Waive the monorail's fare for the district: a holding, held at ₽0.
scene: He doesn't thank anyone. Three days later there's a plant on the base's doorstep in a pot, labelled "Water Thursdays."
"Whippersnapper. I'm going to take me time with ye. It's a kindness."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "Aye. Seen that crop before. Does well a season, then the soil's done."

replace.goes: Keeps gardening the Gym: it's a tree. The Officer's told to mind the roots.

leaders.beaten: Well now. Ye've pruned me back hard. I'll grow again; that's what old things do. Will you, d'ye think, when it's your turn?

toHero.beat: They cut me down proper. Strong growers. Shallow roots, the lot of 'em. Ye can pull a shallow root.
toHero.bend: Whippersnapper. I'm going to take me time with ye. It's a kindness.
toHero.befriend: I gave 'em a seedling. They've kept it. Folk who'll keep a plant alive aren't past hoping for.

leaders.gate: Don't yank at it. Whatever's in there. Ye loosen the soil round a thing first, and see what comes up willing.
leaders.walksIn: (He takes the plant back. That's the scene. If it's died already, he looks at the empty pot for a while.)

leaders.name: Clemont
leaders.says: The capital: a tower, five plazas, cafés, a lab, a press office, and Lysandre's own café, in red. Half the lights are out and everything's a third dearer. He's fifteen; his sister does his talking.

rule.text: The quiz floors: a silhouette, three doors. Then three each, and he's built something that helps. It explodes once a battle.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the quiz floors are on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: No. He's fifteen.

bend.text: A use for his latest invention that isn't a weapon. Flare's offered to buy it; he's said no, and they've not stopped asking.
steps: See off Flare's man in the lab: a Persuade of the lab's director, or a war job.
Put the invention to work where he can see it: the Clinic, the lights or the monorail. A Work, with his machine in it.
scene: The lights come back a quarter at a time, with his machine humming in the middle of it.
"The future is now, thanks to science! And I'm contractually silent on unrelated matters!"

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of their father, Meyer, who's cheerfully certain his children are fine. Profit: "If you pay your bills." Bonnie's the hard one: she asks the Boss if they're a bad guy.
leaders.beaten: Ah! Science has… failed to prevail today. Fascinating! May I ask what your team's energy output— Bonnie, don't, they're busy. (Bonnie: "Are you a bad guy? You've got a bad-guy coat.")

toHero.beat: They won! I've logged all the data. Here: graphs.
toHero.bend: The future is now, thanks to science! And I'm contractually silent on unrelated matters!
toHero.befriend: (Bonnie.) The bad guys put the lights back on. So I asked if they were bad guys and one of them said 'working on it.' I like that one. She's a keeper.

leaders.gate: (Their father, on a motorbike, at the city gate.) Give 'em what for! Or a fair hearing! Whichever! I trust you! Mind the puddle!
leaders.walksIn: (Bonnie, alone; she got out.) You said 'working on it.' You were SUPPOSED to be working on it.

leaders.name: Valerie
leaders.says: A misted town round an ancient tree. A Ball factory beyond, which Flare takes on day 3, and a fashion house. An old town: Persuade's +10%. No Grunt'll take a Capture Rig into that wood.

rule.text: The doll's house: rooms joined by warp tiles, each prettier. Then three each, and she's fairy: half the Doctrines' kits don't touch her.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the doll's house is on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She came from Johto to design for Pokémon, and wishes she were one. You've nothing she can be offered in that line.

bend.text: The factory. Flare's taking every Ball made there, and no Balls means no new partner for any child in Kalos this season.
steps: Hold the factory's gate on day 3, in person, or retake it by day 5.
The Balls go out at cost. A Profit team may keep the factory as a Front, fairly; one that marks the price up's failed.
scene: She has made it a ribbon.
"I shall flutter. You shall struggle. We shall not speak of the others."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit, here, if fair.

replace.goes: Goes into the wood. The Hero sees her at the tree, among Pokémon. She doesn't speak. She gives them a ribbon.

leaders.beaten: Oh. How… elusive of you. I had hoped you might be something rarer than strong. Perhaps you are. One cannot tell by a battle. One wishes one could.

toHero.beat: They defeated me. Their Pokémon were… dressed for work. Not for joy.
toHero.bend: I shall flutter. You shall struggle. We shall not speak of the others.
toHero.befriend: They kept the factory running and the price low. A plain, good thing. I have made it a ribbon.

leaders.gate: The ribbon is for after. Whatever happens in there, wear it out. One should leave looking as if one meant to.
leaders.walksIn: I do not raise my voice. I shall simply stand here, and be seen to have come. (She stands in the yard for an hour. Nobody can work.)

leaders.name: Olympia
leaders.says: A lake town with a great crystal sundial. Old, cold, quiet. She sees ahead: not everything, and not on request. Scout her and the sheet comes back filled in, by her.

rule.text: The star walk: invisible paths over nothing. Then three each, in an order she's chosen by what the challenger will lead with.
rule.waits: Rooms come with the base's defences (slice 10): the star walk is on the door, the fight is singles.

buy.why: She told the scout the offer, the figure, and the day you'd think better of it.

bend.text: She's seen the weapon under Geosenge fire, and not fire. On the fifth day, in person, she asks the Boss one question, and the answer's checked at the Finale.
steps: Be there on the fifth day, in person.
Answer her: "When you can end something for good, will you?" No, or I don't know, bends her on the spot.
scene: "When you can end something for good, will you?"
"The stars say you will lose here twice. I say: attend to the second."

leaders.respectsNote: Whatever she's seen it become.

replace.goes: Can't be, in any test anyone's run. It's allowed.

leaders.beaten: Yes. It was to be so. What was not fixed was your face, afterward. I see you are not glad. Good. There are paths from there.

toHero.beat: They have defeated me. I have seen them defeat you. I have seen you defeat them. I do not yet know which I have seen first.
toHero.bend: The stars say you will lose here twice. I say: attend to the second.
toHero.befriend: There are two endings to this region. They are standing in one and reaching for the other. Help them reach. Or don't. I have seen both.

leaders.gate: One of you will offer the other a way out. I have not been shown which. Take it, or give it. Either is the good path.
leaders.walksIn: (She was expected: she said she'd come, on the scout's sheet, "should it go that way." Anyone with Eyes finds the line afterward. "She knew. Before we did.")

leaders.name: Wulfric
leaders.says: A town in permanent snow by a forest of lost things. A big, kind man who's often out walking: the Hero has to find him before they can fight him.

toHero.beat: Whatever's in there's been somebody's whole life for six weeks. Six weeks is long, when it's all you've got. Go gently, and hit hard. You can do both. I do.

leaders.name: Ilima
leaders.says: Welcome! You're new to Melemele. So's someone else this week: I'm setting their Trial on Thursday. You're welcome to watch from the path. Only from the path, please.

toHero.beat: (Hala gives them the crystal himself, and looks over their shoulder at the Boss while he does it.)

leaders.name: Lana
leaders.says: Pools down a hillside to the sea; a fishing family; a ranch upland. Half the holdings are on water. She's eleven, deadpan, and tells tall stories with a straight face. Guardian: Olivia.

rule.text: Follow the splashing downhill. Each pool's something small. The last isn't. Rain throughout.
rule.waits: The Trial's a Gym battle at A+2 for now: the site's own rooms come with a later build.

buy.why: No. She's eleven.

bend.text: Skull's Grunts are netting the pools for a dealer.
steps: A war job on the netters (one squad: Skull's Grunts aren't hard).
The nets burned, not kept. A Capture Rig used anywhere in this district fails it: she'd know.
scene: "The net people are gone. Some other people did it. I asked if they were pirates. One said 'sort of.' I respect that."
"I can't tell you anything. I did see a Kyogre this morning, though. ...That's also a joke."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Olivia, the Kahuna: "You've a nice way with you. So've a lot of people who've sold me bad stone. I'll watch."
leaders.beaten: Wow. You passed. I once reeled in a Kyogre here, you know. ...That was a joke. You didn't laugh. Most grown-ups at least pretend.

toHero.beat: A grown-up did my Trial. They were good at it. They didn't have fun. I've decided that's sad.
toHero.bend: I can't tell you anything. I did see a Kyogre this morning, though. That's also a joke.
toHero.befriend: The net people are gone. Some other people did it. I asked if they were pirates. One said 'sort of.' I respect that.

leaders.gate: (Olivia, at the Akala quay.) You've good hands, child. Don't make fists of them till you need to.
leaders.walksIn: (Olivia.) I gave you the benefit of the doubt. On my island that's a loan. I've come to collect.

leaders.name: Kiawe
leaders.says: A volcano park, a city below it with a market, a farm he works on before dawn. He's sixteen, fiercely serious, and works two jobs to pay for dance training abroad. Guardian: Olivia.

rule.text: Watch a dance; say what changed. The third time, what's changed is the Totem.
rule.waits: The Trial's a Gym battle at A+2 for now: the site's own rooms come with a later build.

buy.why: No. He's sixteen, and he earns his.

bend.text: A fair chance. He's saving by working a market stall that Skull's Grunts lean on.
steps: See the Grunts off his stall: a war job, or the Boss stands at the stall all day in person.
Nothing's given to him. A team that offers him money's failed it: "I earn mine."
scene: "They stood at my stall a whole day and bought nothing and said nothing. The Grunts did not come back. I have decided to call it a customer's right."
"I will burn at my brightest. My silence is part of the dance."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Olivia, as for Lana.
leaders.beaten: You saw every difference. You have discipline. I respect discipline. I do not yet respect what you spend it on.
