toHero.beat: They passed my Trial without one mistake. A person who makes no mistakes is hiding the ones that matter.
toHero.bend: I will burn at my brightest. My silence is part of the dance.
toHero.befriend: They stood at my stall a whole day and bought nothing and said nothing. The Grunts did not come back.

leaders.gate: (Olivia.) You've good hands, child. Don't make fists of them till you need to.
leaders.walksIn: (Olivia.) I gave you the benefit of the doubt. On my island that's a loan.

leaders.name: Mallow
leaders.says: Jungle, a restaurant her family runs, a lab by the sea, and Aether's first branch office: white, helpful, hiring. She's fifteen, cooks, and over-salts when excited. Guardian: Olivia.

rule.text: Find four ingredients. Cook. What the smell brings is the Totem.
rule.waits: The Trial's a Gym battle at A+2 for now: the site's own rooms come with a later build.

buy.why: No. She's fifteen.

bend.text: Pokémon from the jungle are going to Aether's "conservation" and not coming back.
steps: Scout Aether's branch office to depth 2: the first time the team sees what Aether is.
Tell it: an Expose, with proof, in Olivia's hands, not the paper's. Then eat Mallow's dish. All of it.
scene: "They found out where the jungle Pokémon were going. They told Olivia instead of using it. Olivia cried. Olivia never cries."
"Lips sealed! Like a pot lid! Want some? It's spicy. I mean the fight."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Olivia, as for Lana.
leaders.beaten: Ta-da! You cooked it! It's... okay, it's too salty, that's my recipe, that's on me. Um. Did you want to eat with us? You look like you eat standing up.

toHero.beat: A whole gang did my Trial! They followed the recipe EXACTLY. Nobody follows the recipe exactly. I don't trust it.
toHero.bend: Lips sealed! Like a pot lid! Want some? It's spicy. I mean the fight.
toHero.befriend: They found out where the jungle Pokémon were going. They told Olivia instead of using it.

leaders.gate: (Olivia.) You've good hands, child.
leaders.walksIn: (Olivia.) I gave you the benefit of the doubt. On my island that's a loan. I've come to collect.

leaders.name: Sophocles
leaders.says: A mountain with an observatory, a bus, a city of gardens below. He's eleven, shy, builds things, hides behind his cousin. Ula'ula's Kahuna is Nanu: a tired man in a police uniform, in a station full of Meowth.

rule.text: A quiz by sound. The power goes out each time. The Totem's what's draining it.
rule.waits: The Trial's a Gym battle at A+2 for now: the site's own rooms come with a later build.

buy.why: No. He's eleven.

bend.text: A use for his machine.
steps: Put his gadget to work in a Work of the team's: the Clinic's lamp, or the garden city's pumps. One day.
scene: He comes to see it running. He doesn't speak. He adjusts one screw and leaves.
"I'm, um, not supposed to say. I upgraded the Totem. Sorry."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Nanu, who respects nothing: "Here's what I'll do: nothing. Don't make me do something." It needs Heat under 5 in this district, all district.
leaders.beaten: Oh. Um. You got them all right. Even the... yeah. Um. Molayne? They got them all right. Can they go now?

toHero.beat: Some, um, grown-ups did my Trial. They were quiet. I liked that they were quiet. Molayne says they're bad. They didn't touch any of my stuff.
toHero.bend: I'm, um, not supposed to say. I upgraded the Totem. Sorry.
toHero.befriend: My thing's working. In their clinic. It's, um. It's helping. I didn't know it could do that.

leaders.gate: (Nanu, leaning on the wall with a Meowth.) Kid. I've arrested better people than what's in there and worse, and I never once could tell which was which at the door. Go in. Keep your eyes open. That's the job.
leaders.walksIn: (Nanu, in uniform.) I said don't make me do something.

leaders.name: Acerola
leaders.says: A ruined shop by a black beach; a house for children with no parents, which she helps run; and Po Town, behind a wall: Skull's. She's twelve, cheerful, claims to be royalty, and looks after eight smaller children and a library. Guardian: Nanu.

rule.text: Photograph the ghosts in the shop. The last one photographs back.
rule.waits: The Trial's a Gym battle at A+2 for now: the site's own rooms come with a later build.

buy.why: No. She's twelve.

bend.text: The children's house. Skull took one of its Pokémon: a small one, loved.
steps: Get the Yungoos back from Po Town: a war job, or the Boss walks in, and the first Sit-Down with Guzma's in his room, about this.
It's carried home by a Grunt, not the Boss.
scene: "You sent the nervous one. On purpose?"
"Captain's secret! Royal decree! Also I'm gonna win."

leaders.respectsNote: Asked of Nanu, as for Sophocles.
leaders.beaten: Ooh! You got them all! Even Mimikins! Captain Acerola's super impressed. Hey: you're the scary boat people, right? You don't seem that scary. You seem tired. D'you want a book?

toHero.beat: The boat people did my Trial! They said thank you after. Skull never says thank you.
toHero.bend: Captain's secret! Royal decree! Also I'm gonna win.
toHero.befriend: They got Yungoos back for the little ones. Uncle Nanu says don't trust them. Uncle Nanu says don't trust anyone. I've decided: a bit.

leaders.gate: (Nanu.) Go in. Keep your eyes open. That's the job.
leaders.walksIn: (Nanu, in uniform.) I said don't make me do something. It's a lot of paperwork and I hate it.

leaders.name: Mina
leaders.says: An island with almost nobody on it: a village on boats, a canyon, an altar. Holdings are far apart. She's twenty, the only Captain old enough to be asked anything directly. A painter; vague; forgets she's a Captain.

rule.text: Hers is to go round and battle every other Captain. Each Captain the team's dealt with kindly stands in; each it's Beaten doesn't. Her Trial's as hard as the team's region's been fair.
rule.waits: The Captains standing in are a line on the Card for now; the fight is singles at A+2.

buy.why: She'd lose the money. Not spend it: lose it. In a sketchbook.

bend.text: She paints what she sees and can't finish the one of the team: she can't tell what it is.
steps: Sit for it: in person, a day. The Boss says nothing; she asks three questions while she paints.
scene: "I painted them. It came out warmer than I expected. I checked it wasn't the light."
"I finished the painting. I'm not going to show you. Go look at the real thing."

leaders.respectsNote: And whatever the picture came out as.

replace.goes: Nowhere. She paints on the beach at Seafolk, and the Trial was never a chair anyone sat in.

leaders.beaten: Oh. You did it. Did I give you the petal yet? I'll paint you one. ...You're a hard colour to mix, you know that?

toHero.beat: Somebody did my Trial. Big coat. Sad colours. I gave them a petal, I think.
toHero.bend: I finished the painting. I'm not going to show you. Go look at the real thing.
toHero.befriend: I painted them. It came out warmer than I expected. I checked it wasn't the light.

leaders.gate: (Sketching the base.) Mm? Oh. Go on in. I'll draw whatever comes out.
leaders.walksIn: She brings the painting and paints over it, in the yard, in front of everyone. It takes ten minutes. Nobody stops her.

leaders.name: Hapu
leaders.says: The Grand Trial of Poni, by a Kahuna who's fourteen and was chosen last month. She's never given one before. The Hero's her first. Her grandmother speaks beside her.

toHero.beat: I asked the Tapu about them. It said nothing. Gran says when a Tapu says nothing it's leaving it to you. So. It's left to you.
toHero.bend: This is a small place. Everyone you frighten's somebody's auntie. Tell them I said that. Tell them a Kahuna said that.
toHero.befriend: (Her grandmother, with food for the walk.) Enough for two. You'll see why.

leaders.name: Milo
leaders.says: Oh! Hullo! You're not from round here, are you? Mind the Wooloo, they've no road sense. You here for the match? Lovely. Shop's got pasties if you're peckish.

toHero.beat: (Milo sends a hamper to the base in District 3. No note. It's kindness.)

leaders.name: Nessa
leaders.says: A harbour town: a market, a lighthouse, a seafood restaurant where the Chairman takes people to lunch. The berths are being bought up. The Tide Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The valves: coloured switches, water walls. Then three each, in the rain.
rule.waits: The stadium's puzzle is a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, with the Leader's one gimmick, Dynamax.

buy.why: Her sponsor's her modelling agency. They'd sell. She'd walk, and take the cameras with her.

bend.text: The harbour's being bought up, berth by berth, by a Macro Cosmos shell company.
steps: Take the berths: three water-side holdings, any fair way (a deed's best).
Lease them back to the families at what they paid before. A Profit team can do it at a fair profit. She checks the figure.
scene: "The Okonkwos kept their berth. I asked how. I got a name and a shrug. I'll take it."
"Tide's coming in, and I'm not doing press about it."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit, if fair.

replace.goes: Models full-time. Does an interview. Regard −1.

leaders.beaten: Good match. Really. The crowd liked you, did you hear? They don't know what you are yet. Neither do I. I'd think about what you want them to find out.

toHero.beat: They beat me on telly. Shook my hand. The grip was honest; I'm not sure the rest is.
toHero.bend: Tide's coming in, and I'm not doing press about it.
toHero.befriend: The Okonkwos kept their berth. I asked how. I got a name and a shrug. I'll take it.
toHero.replace: They've a franchise now. A number and a chant. I'm on a billboard.

leaders.gate: The sea doesn't care who's right. It cares who's ready. Be both.
leaders.walksIn: I did press for you. I told a camera you were 'not what people think.' I'd like to know what to tell it now.

leaders.name: Kabu
leaders.says: A city of brick and steam: a canal, a lift, a stadium, mines either side. He's sixty and trains at five every morning. The Ember and Machines Doctrines are at home.

rule.text: The catch-or-beat count: five points in a field of wild Pokémon. Then three each, in the sun.
rule.waits: The stadium's puzzle is a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, with the Leader's one gimmick, Dynamax.

buy.why: He was dropped to the minor league once and came back by running at dawn for nine years. He's the wrong man.

bend.text: He respects one thing: turning up.
steps: Dawn at the canal, in person. Nothing's said.
Dawn at the canal, again. Nothing's said.
Dawn at the canal, a third morning running. He speaks. A Boss who misses a morning starts again.
scene: "The one in charge ran beside me three mornings and did not once try to talk. I know no better reference."
"I shall give you everything. Ask me nothing. Run with me at dawn, after, if you can stand."

leaders.respectsNote: Power: he respects effort, whoever's.

replace.goes: Goes back to Hoenn. Writes to the Hero: one page, on how to lose.

leaders.beaten: Hm. You have trained. That I can see. Training is a promise to oneself. I would like to know what yours promised.

toHero.beat: They defeated me. They had put in the hours. Hours are neutral: a thief may put in hours.
toHero.bend: I shall give you everything. Ask me nothing. Run with me at dawn, after, if you can stand.
toHero.befriend: The one in charge ran beside me three mornings and did not once try to talk. I know no better reference.
toHero.replace: One page, on how to lose. Read it twice.

leaders.gate: You are tired. So are they. The one who can still be courteous when tired is the stronger. Go.
leaders.walksIn: At five in the morning. He waits in the yard until the Boss comes out. "You missed the morning that mattered."

leaders.name: Bea and Allister
leaders.says: A stone town on a ridge: a market, a ruined mural, a stadium two Leaders share. The Gym's Bea's while the sun's up and Allister's after. Allister's ten, masked, and speaks in a whisper. Bea isn't his sister and behaves as if she were.

rule.text: The spinning cups: a ride that throws the challenger about. Then three each: fighting by day; ghosts by night, in the dark.
rule.waits: The stadium's puzzle is a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, with the Leader's one gimmick, Dynamax.

buy.why: No. He's ten. (And Bea's sponsor's her parents' dojo. They'd refuse on her behalf and add two hours to her training.)

bend.text: The mural's about to be broken, by a boy with a Copperajah and a sponsor's orders.
steps: A Grunt takes Bea for sweets (a Heart or a Kind Grunt; nothing else). "Something sweet. Don't tell my mother."
Hold the mural, day 4: an Outplay, in person, against the boy.
scene: "One of them bought me a cream bun. I will not be discussing it."
"...can't say. ...M-my Gengar likes one of them. The old lady who makes soup."

leaders.respectsNote: Allister, through Bea: "He says you can stay. He says the ghosts don't mind you."
leaders.beaten: (Bea.) ... (A bow.) Your form is good. Your spirit is divided. Fix it. (Allister, whispering.) ...'m sorry. I lost. ...you've got a lot of ghosts with you. Not Pokémon ones.

toHero.beat: (Bea.) They won. I have told you their six. I have nothing further.
toHero.bend: (Allister.) ...can't say. ...M-my Gengar likes one of them. The old lady who makes soup.
toHero.befriend: (Bea.) One of them bought me a cream bun. I will not be discussing it.

leaders.gate: (Bea.) Strike once. Mean it. (Allister.) ...and say hi to the soup lady.
leaders.walksIn: Bea, alone, in the yard, doing forms until somebody comes out. It takes two hours. She doesn't stop when they do.

leaders.name: Opal
leaders.says: A town in a glowing wood: mushrooms, a theatre, a Leader of eighty-eight who's looking for a successor and auditions everyone who walks in.

rule.text: The quiz, mid-battle: questions between turns. Right, the challenger's stats rise; wrong, they fall. One's her age. The right answer's "sixteen".
rule.waits: The stadium's puzzle is a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, with the Leader's one gimmick, Dynamax.

buy.why: She's outlived three sponsors. She's the sponsor.

bend.text: A successor: a boy the Chairman's dropped, proud, friendless, good.
steps: Find him: he's living in the stadium's boiler room, Shut. Feed him.
Bring him to her, having been asked, not told: a Persuade, in person, of someone who trusts nobody.
scene: "They've a bit of pink in them after all. I looked very hard. It's at the back, behind the money."
"I've found my successor, with a little help I shan't be describing. You, I intend to flatten. Question one."

replace.goes: Retires to the theatre. Directs. The Hero's cast in something. It's very long.

leaders.beaten: Well! That was a performance. Not a good one, dear. Technically sound. No pink. You've the makings of something and you've dressed it as a bank.

toHero.beat: They beat me, dear. Dreary people. One or two had a glimmer. Here's their order; I wrote it on a napkin.
toHero.bend: I've found my successor, with a little help I shan't be describing. You, I intend to flatten. Question one.
toHero.befriend: They've a bit of pink in them after all. I looked very hard. It's at the back, behind the money.

leaders.gate: Quiz, dear. What's the difference between a villain and a lead? ... The lead gets a second act. See that somebody in there does.
leaders.walksIn: With the boy. He carries her bag. "I told Bede there were people in the world who'd surprise him. I do so hate being made a liar at my age."

leaders.name: Melony
leaders.says: A stone city in the snow: baths, a hotel, a restaurant. The Gym's got two claims on it: a mother who taught her son everything, and the son, Gordie, who left her type and hasn't been home since.

rule.text: The pitfalls: a detector, a field of trapdoors. Then three each, in hail (hers) or sand (his).
rule.waits: The stadium's puzzle is a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, with the Leader's one gimmick, Dynamax.

buy.why: Gordie's sponsor'll sell the fixture: he's a celebrity, the brand's the thing, and a quiet loss to a 'mystery challenger' is good telly.
buy.other: Take the chance Gordie demands after: a Beat, with a handshake, and the Badge is a full tier.

bend.text: The two of them.
steps: An exhibition match, mother against son, for the baths' restoration: a Work, and the stadium's manager Persuaded. Arranged, not fixed.
scene: "They put me and our Gordie in a room. On purpose. I don't know whether to thank them or box their ears."
"I'm going to be ever so hard on you, love, and I shan't say why I'm in such a good mood."

leaders.respectsNote: Melony: Belonging, wholly. Gordie: Profit, Power.

replace.goes: Whichever held it goes to the other's house. It's awkward. It's good for them.

leaders.beaten: Oh, well done, love! Ooh, you're strong. You're not eating, though, are you. I can tell. I've five. Sit down.

toHero.buy: (Gordie.) My sponsor sold a match. I didn't. I want that on record. You're getting a proper one.
toHero.beat: (Gordie.) Yeah, all right. Good match. Don't let it go to your head.
toHero.bend: I'm going to be ever so hard on you, love, and I shan't say why I'm in such a good mood.
toHero.befriend: They put me and our Gordie in a room. On purpose. I don't know whether to thank them or box their ears.

leaders.gate: (Melony.) Wrap up. And be kind, if you can. (Gordie.) And win. Obviously. (Melony.) Gordie.
leaders.walksIn: Melony. She brings food. She puts it on the Mess table. She says, to the room, not the Boss: "Eat that. Then have a think about who you're working for, loves. I'll wait."

leaders.name: Piers
leaders.says: A town in a tunnel with its shutter down: no stadium, no power spot, no Dynamax, no visitors, no money. Team Yell's home. Piers is their singer, Marnie's brother, and the nearest thing they have to a Boss.

rule.text: No Dynamax, for anyone, and no other gimmick: the Gym's a street with a stage at the end. Three each, in the dark.
rule.waits: The street's a line on the Card for now: the fight is singles at A+2, and no gimmick for either side.

buy.why: There's no sponsor. That's the whole trouble with Spikemuth.

bend.text: The town's dying because the League won't run a line to it.
steps: A Work: the shutter mended, and opened.
A Front: the market reopened, fairly.
A gig: the Hall lent, or the stage lit. Yell stop blocking roads the day the shutter's open.
scene: "Someone opened the shutter. Wasn't the League. I've written a song about it. It's not very good. It's happy."
"Got a full house tonight, first in six years. Not sayin' who paid for the lights. I'm gonna sing you out the door, mate."

leaders.respectsNote: Spite: "Against the Chairman? Yeah. Get in line."

replace.goes: Shrugs. "Never wanted it. Marnie's the one." The Officer finds a set list on the chair.

leaders.beaten: Yeah. Figures. Everybody's stronger than Spikemuth. ... You didn't Dynamax. You couldn't, here. Most of 'em complain about that. You didn't. Why's that, then?

toHero.beat: They beat me. No fuss. Didn't sneer at the place. Most do. Dunno what that's worth.
toHero.bend: Got a full house tonight, first in six years. Not sayin' who paid for the lights.
toHero.befriend: Someone opened the shutter. Wasn't the League. I've written a song about it.
toHero.replace: Never wanted it. Marnie's the one. Give it to her when she's ready.

leaders.gate: (With a microphone and no amplifier.) This one's for the kid goin' in. It's short.
leaders.walksIn: With all of Team Yell behind him. They don't shout. That's the scene: forty people, not shouting.

leaders.name: Raihan
leaders.says: A castle city with a vault under it and an energy plant under that. Doubles, in changing weather, against the Champion's rival, who photographs himself losing.

toHero.beat: Half my followers reckon they're heroes. Other half reckon they're villains. I posted a poll. It's fifty-fifty. You're the tiebreak, mate.
toHero.bend: They scare people. I've been a Dragon tamer since I was six: scared's easy. Earning it's the hard bit.
toHero.buy: Word of advice, off the record: whoever's in there owes the Chairman. Everyone who owes the Chairman ends up doing something they didn't plan to.

leaders.name: Katy
leaders.says: Welcome to the patisserie! Oh: not here for cakes. Or a Badge. Hm. You've a look I usually only see on people about to send a cake back. Have a sample. On the house. I'll change your mind about something today.

toHero.beat: (She gives the Hero a Badge and a bag of pastries. Half are in the Hero's bag at the Reckoning, stale. The Hero won't throw them out.)

leaders.name: Brassius
leaders.says: A town of art and windmills and sunflowers. A hedge maze. He's a sculptor; his masterpiece is a figure giving up.

rule.text: The test: find the Sunflora. The Boss finds ten. Then three each; his last one's a tree that's decided to be something else.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: He nearly gave up art once. Somebody talked him round, for nothing. He's not for sale to people who charge.

bend.text: He wants a subject that isn't despair.
steps: Six people at Loyalty 7 or more stand for him, a day, off jobs: he sculpts the Roster, not the Boss.
scene: "I asked to sculpt their underlings. They stood for nine hours and one of them brought me soup. Soup! It's in the piece."
"I have a new muse! Several! I shall crush you in celebration!"

replace.goes: Sculpts. Sculpts the Hero. The Hero's embarrassed.

leaders.beaten: Ahh! Truly avant-garde! No. No, it wasn't. It was competent. Competence is the death of art. What do you feel, when you win? Show me. ... Nothing? Fascinating. Horrifying. Fascinating.

toHero.beat: They beat me with all the passion of a tax return. You, at least, suffer beautifully.
toHero.bend: I have a new muse! Several! I shall crush you in celebration!
toHero.befriend: They stood for nine hours and one of them brought me soup. It's in the piece.

leaders.gate: Art's what's left when you've stopped pretending. Go in there and be a masterpiece. Or a ruin. Both are honest.
leaders.walksIn: He's brought a hammer. He isn't going to use it on anybody. He goes to the Town, and to the piece.

leaders.name: Iono
leaders.says: A city of screens: a harbour, a lighthouse, towers. She streams everything, to a region's worth of viewers.

rule.text: The test: find the director, a man in three camera feeds. It's on her stream, and so's the Boss. Then three each, live, with chat.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: She'd take the envelope, on stream, and open it, on stream. Views'd be astronomical. Yours wouldn't survive it.

bend.text: A fair chance, for the district's nobodies. Her show needs guests.
steps: A Grunt goes on, live, for a day: any Grunt. It goes by their flaw; any of them's the Bend.
scene: "They sent their shyest guy on the show. He froze. Chat LOVES him. He's got a fan club. He doesn't know."
"Your eyeballs are MINE, 'kay? And no spoilers on my new friends!"

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "it's all content, bestie."

replace.goes: Streams from her flat. Streams the Hero's whole run. The Roster watches it instead of the television.

leaders.beaten: Whoa-ho-ho! Chat, are you SEEING this? Total wipe! GG, mystery challenger! ... Stream's off. Okay. Real talk: that was scary good, and chat's split on whether you're a villain arc or a redemption arc.

toHero.beat: They beat me LIVE. I've got the whole VOD. Timestamped. Sent you the link.
toHero.bend: Your eyeballs are MINE, 'kay? And no spoilers on my new friends!
toHero.befriend: They sent their shyest guy on the show. He froze. Chat LOVES him.

leaders.gate: (Streaming.) Chat says good luck! Chat also says 'talk it out,' which, weird, chat never says that. Okay. Going dark. This bit's yours.
leaders.walksIn: Live. She turns the camera round to face the Roster and asks them.

leaders.name: Kofu
leaders.says: A water city on terraces, with a market town down the hill where there's an auction daily. He's a chef; he's enormous; he loses his wallet. The Tide Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The test: the auction. Buy the seaweed, fairly; the bidding's the test. Then three each.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: He'd cook the money. Not as a joke: he'd forget what it was and put it in a stock.

bend.text: The market's catch is being bought ahead of the auction by a buyer's ring.
steps: Bring his wallet back, with everything in it.
Break the ring: an Expose, with the ring's ledger, or outbid it fairly for three days, at a loss.
scene: "They brought my wallet back. Full! In this city! I have been robbed by honest men for forty years and now thieves return my wallet. I need to lie down."
"I am going to serve you a FEAST of defeat, chiquito, and I am not sharing the recipe!"

leaders.respectsNote: Profit, if fair.

replace.goes: Cooks. Feeds the Hero. The Hero's team is healed past full.

leaders.beaten: HAH! Vaya! Filleted! No, no, wonderful, wonderful. You're hungry. Not for food. I know hungry. Sit. I'll make you something anyway and we'll see what it fixes.

toHero.beat: They beat me! Precise. Like a knife that's never cut anything it liked. I wrote their menu down for you.
toHero.bend: I am going to serve you a FEAST of defeat, chiquito!
toHero.befriend: They brought my wallet back. Full! In this city!

leaders.gate: (With a covered dish.) For after. For two. You'll see.
leaders.walksIn: He goes to the Mess, not the Office. He tastes what's on the stove. He puts the spoon down. "It needs salt. So do you."

leaders.name: Larry
leaders.says: A town of restaurants with a view. He's an office worker. He's a Gym Leader because his boss told him to be. He eats lunch at the same place daily and it's his test.

rule.text: The test: the secret menu. Find four clues in town; order the right thing. Then three each. His are ordinary. They win a lot.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: It's not for him. The restaurant he's eaten at for eleven years is closing: the landlord's doubled the rent. He'd throw a match for exactly eleven months of their rent and not a coin more, and file a report on himself afterward.
buy.other: Take on the lease (a Pay to the landlord), or buy the building and charge the old rent. It bends him.

bend.text: Lunch. The restaurant's closing.
steps: Take on the lease: a fair Pay to the landlord.
Nobody tells his boss. A team that makes a noise about its kindness has failed: Geeta inspects.
scene: "The restaurant's still open. I've not asked how. In my experience, when something good happens at work, you don't send a follow-up email."
"I'll be giving this my full attention. It's unusual for me. Don't read into it."

leaders.respectsNote: Profit: "It's a job. I've a job. I understand jobs." Not Cause: "I've sat through the presentation."

replace.goes: Is relieved. Goes back to the office full-time. Is promoted. Is given the Gym back, as extra duties, within the month.

leaders.beaten: Well. That's that. I'll write it up. ... Off the record: you're very good. Somebody told you to, once, and you never checked whether they still meant it.

toHero.buy: I underperformed. Deliberately. It's in my report, which nobody'll read. Come back Thursday; I'll do it properly on my lunch hour.
toHero.bend: I'll be giving this my full attention. It's unusual for me. Don't read into it.
toHero.befriend: The restaurant's still open. I've not asked how.

leaders.gate: (In a suit, with a briefcase.) I'm on my break. I've four minutes. Let them speak first; write nothing down; and order the same as them.
leaders.walksIn: With a form. He's filled it in. It's a complaint. He hands the Boss a copy. "You've fourteen days to respond."

leaders.name: Ryme
leaders.says: A town on a snow peak with a stage. She raps; she's seventy; her sister teaches maths at the Academy and they haven't shared a stage in thirty years. The Ghosts Doctrine's at home.

rule.text: The test: the crowd. Double battles, on stage; each junior beaten brings more audience, and the audience boosts whoever's winning.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: She's been offered record deals for fifty years. She knows a bad contract by its smell.

bend.text: Her sister.
steps: Ask the sister whether she wants to go: a Persuade, in person. She wants "a reason that isn't sentiment".
Drive her up the mountain: two days, through snow, in a van with a broken heater.
scene: "Thirty years. They drove her up a mountain in a van with a broken heater. I don't care what else they did this week."
"My sister's in the front row tonight, sugar. I ain't sayin' how."

leaders.respectsNote: Spite: "I wrote three albums out of it. Then I wrote a better one."

replace.goes: Tours. The Hero hears her in every later town, from a window.

leaders.beaten: Ooh. Cold. Colder than my mountain, and child, that's cold. You got flow. You got no soul in it. Who took it? Go get it back. I'll wait.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Tight set. No heart. I wrote down their whole verse for you.

leaders.gate: Listen for the beat under what they say. Everybody's got one. It don't lie, even when the words do.
leaders.walksIn: She doesn't rap it. She says it plain, and slowly.

leaders.name: Tulip
leaders.says: A hill town nobody can reach: no road, only a cave. She's a make-up artist of fame, a psychic, and stern.

rule.text: The test: the emotions. Match the expression: joy, anger, surprise. The Boss does it, in front of the squad. Then three each.
rule.waits: The test's a line on the Card for now: the Boss does it, and the fight is singles at A+2. The test as a small scene of its own comes later.

buy.why: Her client list would buy your region.

bend.text: The town's dying of being unreachable.
steps: The road: a Work, the dearest in the mode. And the road's free: a team that puts a toll on it's failed.
scene: "They built a road to a town of two hundred people, and didn't charge. I looked very hard for the angle. There's a small one. It's mostly not."
"I've a road, darling. I'm in a marvellous mood. You're going to hate it."

replace.goes: Returns to her salon. Does the Hero's mother's make-up for the epilogue's photograph.

leaders.beaten: Flawless technique. And under it: you're sad, you're angry, and you're hiding both under 'determined.' I do this for a living, darling. Fix your foundation.

toHero.beat: They beat me. Their leader's wearing three feelings and showing one. I've listed which.
toHero.bend: I've a road, darling. I'm in a marvellous mood. You're going to hate it.
toHero.befriend: They built a road to a town of two hundred people, and didn't charge.

leaders.gate: Whatever face they've got on in there, it's not the one underneath. Nor's yours. Take them both off.
leaders.walksIn: She looks at the Boss for a long time. "Oh, darling. There it is. I'd hoped I was wrong."

leaders.name: Grusha
leaders.says: A mountain. A young man who was the best snowboarder in the region until a fall, and who trains now with the stillness of somebody who's lost one life and built a second.

toHero.beat: I've heard good things. I don't trust good things. Go carefully.
toHero.bend: Fear's a slope. It only goes one way. They'll know that by now.
toHero.befriend: I had one thing I was, and I lost it in four seconds. What's in that base is the one thing somebody is. Remember what that's like to lose, if you take it.
